about.title: A dealer for people looking for more than just a car
about.text1: At OTEN MOTORS, we believe buying a car should be simple, transparent and safe. We focus on a carefully chosen selection of nearly new and used cars, with an eye for quality, attention to detail and close, personal support.
about.text2: More than selling cars, we want to build lasting relationships of trust, making sure every customer finds the right solution for their needs.

finance.disclaimer: Purely indicative calculation tool, for the user's own use only. The figures come solely from the data you entered and are not a credit proposal, offer, recommendation or credit advertising. OTEN MOTORS does not grant credit, is not a credit intermediary, has no relationship with any lender and does not assess, propose or forward finance applications. The calculation uses monthly compound interest on the amount financed and does not include APR, fees, stamp duty, insurance or other charges. The accepted rate is limited to between {min}% and {max}%; the upper limit is the legal maximum APR for used-car credit set by Banco de Portugal for {period}. For real, binding terms, contact a credit institution authorised by Banco de Portugal.

finder.subtitle: Answer 5 quick questions. Based on studies and listings from Portugal's used-car market, we suggest the models and years that make sense for you, and show what we have in stock.
finder.waiting: Answer the 5 questions to see our analysis ({answered}/5).

finder.whatsappMessage: Hi! I'm looking for a car. Budget: {budget}. Type: {body}. Use: {use}. Km per year: {km}. Gearbox: {gearbox}. Your website's assistant suggested: {models}. Can you help me find one?

reason.dieselRoad: With high mileage on open roads, diesel is still the cheapest per kilometre. That's why it's the most sought-after fuel on Portugal's used market (47% of demand). If you'd rather avoid diesel, a hybrid is the alternative.
reason.dieselMixed: At over 20,000 km a year, a diesel pays for itself quickly, even in mixed driving. If part of the journey is in town, a hybrid is a good alternative.
reason.hybridCity: In town, a hybrid uses little fuel in stop-start traffic because it recovers energy when braking, and it never needs charging. If you can charge at home, an electric car lowers the cost per km even further.
reason.hybridMixed: For mixed driving and average mileage, a hybrid is the sweet spot: it saves in town without penalising you on the open road. Petrol is the cheapest to buy.
reason.petrolLow: Under 10,000 km a year, a diesel never makes up for its higher price and servicing costs. Petrol is cheaper to buy and to run.
reason.petrolLowCity: With low mileage, mostly in town, petrol is the cheapest choice to buy. If your budget allows, a hybrid uses much less in traffic.

finder.chargeHome: Electric cars only pay off if you can charge at home or at work.
finder.disclaimer: Suggestions based on studies, rankings and listings from Portugal's used-car market (2025–2026). Years are a guide only: the price always depends on mileage, version and condition.
finder.relaxed: We couldn't find this type of car within this budget and preferences. These are the closest alternatives.
